# users oidc-claims

Display the OIDC claims for the authenticated user.

## Usage

```console
optimus-ide-collab users oidc-claims [flags]
```

## Description

```console
  - Display your OIDC claims:

     $ optimus-ide-collab users oidc-claims

  - Display your OIDC claims as JSON:

     $ optimus-ide-collab users oidc-claims -o json
```
